note: Ten printables. All adult-facing text sits outside the trim rectangles. The A6 card sheets tile the page exactly, so they carry the only marks a tiling sheet safely can: a tick at each of the four page-edge midpoints and a hairline cross at the page centre — the five positions that fall in the same physical place on both faces under either duplex flip.
trayThreeLetterTin: a b c d e g h i m n o p r t u

items.title: Sound-frame mat — 3-frame 70 mm / 4-frame 66 mm
items.cut: One cut: trim the mat out on the dotted rectangle, 282 × 100 mm — the same rectangle on both sides, so one cut serves both faces. Front: three 70 mm frames with 6 mm gutters. Back: four 66 mm frames with 4 mm gutters.
items.howToPrint: Print 1 sheet DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100% on card; one cut on the dotted rectangle; matt-laminate.

items.title: Chain cards ×6
items.cut: Cut each sheet in half, then in half again on the two midlines: four A6 cards, 105 × 148.5 mm. Ticks at the four page-edge midpoints and a cross at the centre mark them, on both faces.
items.howToPrint: Print 2 sheets DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100%, four A6 cards per sheet.

items.title: Dictation photo cards ×12
items.cut: Cut each sheet in half, then in half again on the two midlines: four A6 cards, 105 × 148.5 mm. Ticks at the four page-edge midpoints and a cross at the centre mark them, on both faces.
items.howToPrint: Print 3 sheets DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100%, four A6 cards per sheet.

items.title: Small objects — 5 heart words, 7 blanks, 3 punctuation tiles
items.cut: 15 pieces: 12 cards at 60 × 35 mm and 3 tiles at 34 × 42 mm. Punch the rings.
items.howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on thick card; LAMINATE the whole sheet, THEN cut.

items.title: Lined sentence strips, 190 × 60 mm
items.cut: Cut 4 strips, 190 × 60 mm, on the dotted rectangles.
items.howToPrint: Print plenty, single-sided at 100% on plain paper; 4 strips per sheet.

items.title: Picture sequences ×3 (12 cards)
items.cut: Cut 12 cards, 90 × 90 mm, four per sheet, on the dotted rectangles. All three sheets now carry them, with a tick at the page edge on every cut line.
items.howToPrint: Print 3 sheets single-sided at 100% on card; one complete set per sheet.

items.title: Fold-book template
items.cut: One cut, along the amber line in the middle of the sheet. Three folds.
items.howToPrint: Print single-sided at 100% (never “fit to page”); one sheet = one 8-page book.

items.title: Story-dictation sheet
items.howToPrint: Print 20 copies single-sided at 100% on plain paper; keep them in one folder.

items.title: Teacher script card, 2-up A5
items.cut: One cut down the middle: two identical A5 cards, 148.5 × 210 mm.
items.howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on card; one cut; laminate both.

items.title: Grammar pack — 12 tokens + 4 control cards
items.cut: 16 pieces: 12 tokens on page 1, 4 cards at 190 × 60 mm on page 2.
items.howToPrint: Print 2 sheets single-sided in colour at 100%; LAMINATE both sheets, THEN cut.

revised: 2026-09-05 — sound-frame mat enlarged to 70 mm / 66 mm frames; cut guides added to 02, 03 and 06.
